scientific_integrity: Analytical proof with exhaustive small-board and sampled larger-board finite checks. Standard PBH and incidence-cycle facts cited; no claim of new general maximum-multiplicity principle. Independent audit not performed.
scientific_limitations: Two-factor complete-graph products, direction-constant positive weights, exact finite-dimensional LTI terminal-input controllability; no control-energy or robustness theorem.
title: Forest and component-imbalance criteria for controllability of weighted rook networks
